actions.reason: C0001 has coherent, strong biological identity evidence (29/50 HALLMARK pathways significant with large effect sizes, reciprocal to C0002; coherent CNV pattern of 3p tumor-suppressor loci and 14q loss). Cross-modal membership is supported with positive silhouettes across all five modalities and moderate fused resampling stability (ARI 0.434), and the boundary to C0002 is weak in fused/WXS space but clearer in RNA. Confounder testing shows a tissue-source-site imbalance but no CT technical association, and the categorical effect does not exceed the warning threshold, so no plausible competing explanation is supported. Known-label echo is near zero for stage and grade. Residual uncertainty from modest boundary separation and site imbalance is retained but not decision-critical for retaining this discovery-stage candidate.

C0002 has coherent, strong biological identity evidence reciprocal to C0001 (29/50 HALLMARK pathways significant with large effect sizes; coherent reciprocal CNV pattern). Cross-modal membership is supported with positive silhouettes in four of five modalities (WXS marginal) and estimable fused structure, though resampling stability is lower (ARI 0.243). Boundary separation from C0001 is modest in fused/WXS space but clearer in RNA. Confounder testing shows a tissue-source-site imbalance without CT technical association and below the warning threshold, so no plausible competing explanation is supported. Known-label echo is near zero. Residual uncertainty from marginal WXS support, lower stability, and site imbalance is retained but not decision-critical for retaining this discovery-stage candidate.
